title: Spielberg's letter to James Fox about 'I Know What I Saw'

tellings.quote: Famed UFO documentarian James Fox revealed a letter that Spielberg had sent regarding his 2009 documentary,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that James Fox, a well-known maker of UFO documentaries, revealed a letter sent to him by the film director Steven Spielberg. The letter was about Fox's 2009 documentary, I Know What I Saw. Michels tells it because it would suggest one of the world's most famous filmmakers takes the subject seriously.
